title: 第12章 有猫腻，诡物降临？-《开局三预言？我直播通关S级末世》
content:
第(1/3)页

    张老师是她大学时期十分敬重的一位老教授，博学多识，为人风趣幽默，他的课堂永远都是满满当当的。

    可是现在，这位德高望重的老教授，才给她发了请求信息，系统就弹出来支线任务。

    重大的生命危机……

    上一世，她并没有接到张老师的信息，也没有经历方言大张旗鼓的求复合。

    一直到诡异全面降临，他们家都没有发生任何异常。

    诡异降临的第一个月，他们一家人在搜集物资时意外遇到方言，后来便死皮赖脸跟着他们一家回来了。

    那时候的她也是恋爱脑，经不住方言的软磨硬泡，最终还是和好，一直到被背叛送上祭台。

    而现在，事情的轨迹彻底偏离了上一世的记忆，发生了翻天覆地的改变。

    靳兰玦有种直觉，张老师突然找上门，绝对跟靳建国这伙人少不了关联。

    她看向自己的直播间，突然露出一抹笑容：

    “走啊，带你们逛街去。”

    她在心中呼叫系统：开启随身直播。

    【咚——】

    一声系统提示音后，手机上的直播消失了，取而代之的，是面前虚空中，以她视角为主的画面，清晰得就像是她自己看到的世界一样。

    【芜~大师换镜头了？感觉好清晰】

    【大师您的镜头放在哪里啦，绑在脑袋上吗哈哈哈】

    【哇真不错】

    靳兰玦看着面前虚空中的弹幕刷刷而过，挑拣着问题，一本正经地胡说八道：

    “镜头我戴在耳钉上的，内测新产品。”

    张教授约的，是一个位置比较偏僻的工业区，那里有一小片创意园，位置关系，几乎看不到游客。

    靳兰玦推开咖啡店的门，门口的铃铛“叮当”一声，室内没有老板和服务员。

    唯一一桌客人坐在远离窗户的角落，还有一盆大大的绿植做了隔断。

    远远的，靳兰玦就在他的周身看到了隐约缠绕的黑色诡气。

    靳兰玦脚下微顿，心生怀疑，这看上去不是靳业平的手法。

    难不成靳业平，已经琢磨出可以驾驭诡气的法子了？

    张教授看到她，立刻站起来，表情强压着镇定，露出笑容抬手招呼：

    “兰玦来啦，快来，坐。”
    第(1/3)页

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Teacher Zhang is an old professor whom she respected very much in college. He is knowledgeable and humorous. His class is always full.

But now, this respected old professor has just sent her a request message, and a side mission pops up in the system.

A major life crisis...

In her last life, she did not receive any message from Teacher Zhang, nor did she experience Fang Yan’s high-profile request for reconciliation.

Until the strangeness came, nothing unusual happened in their house.

In the first month when the strangeness came, their family accidentally encountered Fang Yan while collecting supplies, and then shamelessly followed their family back.

At that time, she was also in love, unable to withstand the tough words of dialect, and finally reconciled, until she was betrayed and sent to the altar.

But now, the trajectory of things has completely deviated from the memory of the previous life, and has undergone earth-shaking changes.

Jin Lanjue had an intuition that Teacher Zhang's sudden visit must be related to Jin Jianguo and his group.

She looked at her live broadcast room and suddenly smiled:

“Let’s go, I’ll take you shopping.”

She called the system in her heart: start the portable live broadcast.

【咚——】

After a system beep, the live broadcast on the mobile phone disappeared, replaced by the picture in the void in front of her, mainly from her perspective, as clear as the world she saw herself.

【武~Master, did you change the lens?It feels so clear]

【Master, where is your lens? Is it tied to your head? Hahaha】

【Wow, that’s really good】

Jin Lanjue looked at the barrages passing by in the void in front of him, picked out the questions, and said nonsense seriously:

"I wear the lens on my earrings for internal testing of new products."

Professor Zhang made an appointment in a relatively remote industrial area. There is a small creative park there. Due to the location, there are almost no tourists.

Jin Lanjue pushed open the door of the coffee shop, and the bell at the door jingled. There was no boss or waiter in the room.

The only table of guests sat in the corner away from the window, and there was a large pot of green plants as a partition.

From a distance, Jin Lanjue saw a vaguely entangled black aura around him.

Jin Lanjue paused slightly, feeling suspicious. This did not seem to be Jin Yeping's method.

Is it possible that Jin Yeping has figured out a way to control the evil spirit?

Professor Zhang stood up immediately when he saw her, his expression remained calm, he smiled and raised his hand to say hello:

"Lan Jue is here, come quickly and sit down."
